title: Yellowed Char Croatian Sweet Potatoes Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Croatian dish featuring fermented sweet potatoes, char-grilled to perfection and served on skewers. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a snack or dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the sweet potatoes, yogurt, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Let the mixture ferment for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the fermented sweet potatoes onto the soaked wooden skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes or until the sweet potatoes are tender and lightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
Let the skewers cool down for a few minutes before serving to kids.
You can serve the skewers with a side of lacto-vegetarian-friendly dips or sauces.
